================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 1
              DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
================================================================================

1.1  Defined Terms. Capitalised terms used in this Agreement have the meanings
     set out in Schedule 1. Additional defined terms may appear in the body of
     this Agreement; in the event of conflict, Schedule 1 shall prevail unless
     the body provision expressly states otherwise.

1.2  Interpretation.
     (a) References to an "Article", "Section", or "Schedule" are references to
         an Article, Section or Schedule of or to this Agreement.
     (b) Words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa.
     (c) Any reference to a statutory provision includes any amendment,
         re-enactment or subordinate legislation made under it.
     (d) "Including" means "including without limitation".
     (e) Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.
     (f) References to "writing" include email to the extent permitted by
         Section 13.5.
     (g) Where a representation or warranty is qualified by "to the Seller's
         Knowledge", such knowledge shall mean the actual knowledge of the
         individuals listed in Schedule 1 (Knowledge Persons) after reasonable
         inquiry.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 2
               SALE AND PURCHASE OF SHARES
================================================================================

2.1  Sale and Purchase. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement,
     at Closing, Seller shall sell, transfer, assign, and deliver to Buyer, and
     Buyer shall purchase and acquire from Seller, all of the Shares, free and
     clear of all Encumbrances, together with all rights attaching thereto at
     Closing (including all dividends and distributions declared, paid or made
     on or after the Locked-Box Date / Effective Date).

2.2  No Encumbrances. Seller represents and warrants that at Closing it will
     have good and marketable title to the Shares, free and clear of any
     Encumbrances. Seller shall take all steps necessary to procure the release
     of any Encumbrances prior to or at Closing.

2.3  Third-Party Rights. The Shares shall be sold with full title guarantee (or
     equivalent under the governing law) and with all third-party rights and
     entitlements that attach to them as at the Closing Date.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 3
                       CONSIDERATION
================================================================================

3.1  Purchase Price. The aggregate consideration for the Shares shall be
     [PURCHASE PRICE] (the "Purchase Price"), subject to adjustment as provided
     in Sections 3.2 through 3.5.

3.2  Purchase Price Adjustments.
     (a) Locked-Box Mechanism (if applicable). If the parties have agreed to a
         locked-box mechanism, the Purchase Price shall be the Locked-Box Price
         as set out in Schedule 7 (Locked-Box), subject to adjustment for
         Permitted Leakage and any identified Leakage.
     (b) Completion Accounts Mechanism (if applicable). If the parties have
         agreed to a completion-accounts mechanism:
         (i)  The Purchase Price shall be calculated by reference to the
              Completion Accounts prepared in accordance with Schedule 7
              (Completion Accounts);
         (ii) The Estimated Purchase Price shall be paid at Closing;
         (iii)The Purchase Price shall be adjusted post-Closing in accordance
              with Schedule 7.

3.3  Earn-Out (if applicable). To the extent the parties have agreed to
     an earn-out arrangement, the terms and targets shall be set out in an
     Earn-Out Schedule appended hereto as Schedule 7A.

3.4  Payment. At Closing, Buyer shall pay the [Estimated] Purchase Price by
     wire transfer of immediately available funds to the bank account(s)
     designated by Seller in writing at least five (5) Business Days prior to
     Closing.

3.5  Escrow. [●]% of the Purchase Price ([ESCROW AMOUNT]) shall be deposited
     into escrow with [ESCROW AGENT] pursuant to the Escrow Agreement and
     shall be held as partial security for Seller's indemnification obligations
     under Article 9. The Escrow Amount shall be released as follows:
     (a) [●]% on the date that is twelve (12) months after the Closing Date; and
     (b) the remainder on the date that is twenty-four (24) months after the
         Closing Date,
     in each case subject to outstanding and unresolved indemnification claims.

3.6  Allocation. The parties shall use commercially reasonable efforts to agree
     on an allocation of the Purchase Price among the assets of the Company
     for Tax purposes in accordance with applicable law, within sixty (60) days
     after the Closing Date.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 4
                  CONDITIONS PRECEDENT
================================================================================

4.1  Conditions to Buyer's Obligations. The obligation of Buyer to consummate
     the transactions contemplated by this Agreement is subject to the
     satisfaction (or waiver by Buyer) of each of the following conditions on
     or prior to the Closing Date:

     (a) Regulatory Approvals. All Regulatory Approvals identified in
         Schedule 9 shall have been obtained, made, or given and shall remain
         in full force and effect, including (without limitation):
         (i)  Any applicable merger control clearance;
         (ii) Foreign investment review approvals (if applicable);
         (iii)Sector-specific regulatory approvals set out in Schedule 9.

     (b) Seller's Warranties. The Seller's Warranties set out in Schedule 3
         shall be true and correct (i) as of the date of this Agreement and
         (ii) as of the Closing Date with the same effect as if made on and as
         of such date (except for warranties that expressly relate to an earlier
         date, which shall be true and correct as of such earlier date), except
         where the failure to be true and correct would not, individually or in
         the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

     (c) Seller's Performance. Seller shall have performed and complied in all
         material respects with each covenant and obligation required to be
         performed or complied with by Seller at or prior to Closing.

     (d) No Material Adverse Effect. Since the Accounts Date, no Material
         Adverse Effect shall have occurred or be continuing.

     (e) Required Consents. All Required Consents identified in Schedule 4
         shall have been obtained in form and substance reasonably satisfactory
         to Buyer.

     (f) No Restraint. No Governmental Authority shall have enacted, issued,
         promulgated, enforced, or entered any Order that is then in effect and
         that restrains, enjoins, makes illegal, or otherwise prohibits the
         consummation of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement.

     (g) Closing Deliverables. Seller shall have delivered (or stand ready to
         deliver) all items listed in Schedule 6.

4.2  Conditions to Seller's Obligations. The obligation of Seller to consummate
     the transactions contemplated by this Agreement is subject to the
     satisfaction (or waiver by Seller) of each of the following conditions:

     (a) Buyer's Warranties. The Buyer's warranties set out in Article 8 shall
         be true and correct in all material respects as of the Closing Date.

     (b) Buyer's Performance. Buyer shall have performed and complied in all
         material respects with each covenant and obligation required to be
         performed or complied with by Buyer at or prior to Closing.

     (c) No Restraint. No Governmental Authority shall have enacted, issued,
         promulgated, enforced, or entered any Order restraining, enjoining, or
         prohibiting the consummation of the transactions.

     (d) Payment. Buyer shall have tendered (or shall tender simultaneously at
         Closing) the [Estimated] Purchase Price in accordance with Section 3.4.

4.3  Efforts; Cooperation. Each party shall use its reasonable best efforts to
     satisfy the conditions set out in Sections 4.1 and 4.2 as soon as
     reasonably practicable, and shall cooperate with the other party in
     connection with the making of all filings, notifications, and submissions
     required in connection with the Regulatory Approvals.

4.4  Termination for Failure of Conditions. If any condition in Section 4.1 or
     4.2 has not been satisfied (or waived) on or before the Long-Stop Date,
     either party may terminate this Agreement in accordance with Section 13.11.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 5
             PRE-CLOSING COVENANTS
================================================================================

5.1  Conduct of Business. During the period from the date of this Agreement
     until Closing, except as set out in Schedule 5 or as Buyer shall otherwise
     consent to in writing (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld,
     conditioned, or delayed), Seller shall cause the Group to:

     (a) carry on the Business in the ordinary course of business consistent
         with past practice;
     (b) use commercially reasonable efforts to preserve intact the Business,
         maintain the goodwill of suppliers, customers, and other persons with
         whom the Group has material business relationships;
     (c) maintain all Permits and Licences necessary for the operation of the
         Business;
     (d) maintain in force all insurance policies identified in Schedule 17;
     (e) comply in all material respects with all applicable laws and
         regulations.

5.2  Negative Covenants. Without limiting Section 5.1, during the Pre-Closing
     Period, Seller shall not permit any member of the Group to (without
     Buyer's prior written consent):

     (a) amend any Group Company's constitutional documents;
     (b) issue, allot, or grant any securities, options, warrants, or
         convertible instruments;
     (c) acquire or dispose of any business, material asset, or Subsidiary
         outside the ordinary course;
     (d) incur any Indebtedness outside the ordinary course exceeding
         [THRESHOLD] in the aggregate;
     (e) declare, make, or pay any dividend or other distribution;
     (f) make any capital expenditure commitment exceeding [THRESHOLD]
         individually or [THRESHOLD] in the aggregate;
     (g) enter into, amend, or terminate any Material Contract;
     (h) initiate, settle, or compromise any Litigation exceeding [THRESHOLD];
     (i) change any accounting policies or methods;
     (j) make or change any material Tax election or submit any amended
         Tax Return;
     (k) hire or terminate any Key Employee or materially alter any employee's
         compensation or benefits.

5.3  Access. Subject to applicable law and any applicable confidentiality
     obligations, Seller shall provide Buyer and its representatives reasonable
     access during normal business hours, upon reasonable prior written notice,
     to the properties, books, records, and personnel of the Group for purposes
     of Closing preparation, integration planning, and monitoring compliance
     with this Article 5.

5.4  Notification. Seller shall promptly notify Buyer of:
     (a) any event, occurrence, or circumstance that has resulted in, or that
         Seller reasonably believes would result in, a Material Adverse Effect;
     (b) any breach of any warranty, covenant, or obligation of Seller under
         this Agreement; and
     (c) any development that would require an update to the Disclosure
         Schedules.

5.5  Regulatory Filings. Each party shall, as promptly as practicable after
     the date of this Agreement, prepare and file all required notifications,
     filings, and submissions with Governmental Authorities in connection with
     the transactions (as set out in Schedule 9), and shall keep the other
     party reasonably informed of the status thereof.

5.6  Financing Cooperation. Seller shall, and shall cause the Group to, provide
     such cooperation and assistance as Buyer reasonably requests in connection
     with any financing obtained by Buyer to fund the Purchase Price, including
     providing customary management presentations and access to due diligence
     materials.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 6
                          CLOSING
================================================================================

6.1  Closing Date. Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions set out
     in Article 4, Closing shall take place at [LOCATION] on the date that is
     five (5) Business Days after the date on which the last condition set out
     in Article 4 (other than conditions to be satisfied at Closing) is
     satisfied or waived, or such other date as the parties may agree in writing
     (the "Closing Date").

6.2  Seller's Closing Deliverables. At Closing, Seller shall deliver (or cause
     to be delivered) to Buyer each item listed in Part A of Schedule 6,
     including (without limitation):

     (a) duly executed stock transfer form(s) or equivalent instruments
         transferring the Shares to Buyer;
     (b) original share certificate(s) representing the Shares (or an
         indemnity for lost certificates in agreed form);
     (c) written resignations of any directors of Group Companies (as agreed
         between the parties), effective as of Closing;
     (d) evidence of release and discharge of all Encumbrances over the Shares
         and the assets of the Group;
     (e) evidence of receipt of all Required Consents (Schedule 4);
     (f) all corporate Books and Records of each Group Company;
     (g) a certified copy of the resolutions of Seller's governing body
         authorising execution and performance of this Agreement;
     (h) a bring-down certificate executed by a duly authorised officer of
         Seller confirming satisfaction of the conditions in Sections 4.1(b)
         and 4.1(c);
     (i) any other items listed in Schedule 6.

6.3  Buyer's Closing Deliverables. At Closing, Buyer shall deliver (or cause
     to be delivered) to Seller each item listed in Part B of Schedule 6,
     including (without limitation):

     (a) payment of the [Estimated] Purchase Price in accordance with
         Section 3.4;
     (b) payment of the Escrow Amount to the Escrow Agent;
     (c) a certified copy of resolutions of Buyer's governing body authorising
         execution and performance of this Agreement;
     (d) a bring-down certificate executed by a duly authorised officer of
         Buyer confirming satisfaction of the conditions in Sections 4.2(a)
         and 4.2(b).

6.4  Simultaneous Actions. All actions at Closing shall be deemed to take place
     simultaneously, and no delivery or payment shall be deemed to have been
     made until all deliveries and payments required at Closing have been made.

6.5  Failure to Close. If any party fails to comply with any of its obligations
     under this Article 6, the other party may (without prejudice to any other
     rights or remedies available to it):
     (a) proceed to Closing to the extent practicable; or
     (b) fix a new Closing date not more than fifteen (15) Business Days later;
         or
     (c) terminate this Agreement in accordance with Section 13.11 (if such
         failure constitutes a material breach that is not cured within five (5)
         Business Days of written notice).

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 7
        SELLER'S REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
================================================================================

7.1  Seller's Warranties. Seller makes the representations and warranties set
     out in Schedule 3 (Seller's Warranties) to Buyer as at the date of this
     Agreement and, except where a warranty is stated to be made as at a
     specific date, as at the Closing Date.

7.2  Disclosure. The Seller's Warranties are given subject to matters that are
     fairly disclosed in the Disclosure Letter delivered to Buyer on the date of
     this Agreement (as updated in accordance with Section 5.4), with sufficient
     detail to enable Buyer to identify the nature and scope of the matter
     disclosed.

7.3  Warranty Limitations. The liability of Seller under the Seller's Warranties
     is subject to the limitations set out in Schedule 3 (Limitation on
     Liability), including:

     (a) De Minimis: no Claim shall be made unless the Loss in respect of that
         individual Claim exceeds [DE MINIMIS AMOUNT];
     (b) Basket/Threshold: no Claim shall be made unless the aggregate Losses
         in respect of all Claims exceed [BASKET AMOUNT] (in which case the
         full amount, not just the excess, shall be recoverable — "first dollar"
         basket) / (in which case only the excess over the Basket shall be
         recoverable — "deductible" basket);
     (c) Cap: the aggregate liability of Seller for all Claims under the
         Seller's Warranties (other than Fundamental Warranties) shall not exceed
         [CAP AMOUNT];
     (d) Fundamental Warranty Cap: the aggregate liability of Seller for all
         Claims under Fundamental Warranties shall not exceed the Purchase Price;
     (e) Time Limits:
         (i)  Claims under Fundamental Warranties must be notified within seven
              (7) years after the Closing Date;
         (ii) Claims under Tax Warranties must be notified within seven (7) years
              (or applicable statute of limitations period, if longer);
         (iii)Claims under all other Seller's Warranties must be notified within
              [18/24] months after the Closing Date;
     (f) Mitigation: Buyer shall take commercially reasonable steps to mitigate
         any Loss;
     (g) No Double Recovery: Buyer shall not be entitled to recover the same
         Loss more than once.

7.4  Seller's Knowledge. Where a Seller's Warranty is qualified by "to the
     Seller's Knowledge", such knowledge shall have the meaning given in
     Schedule 1.

7.5  No Other Warranties. Except for the Seller's Warranties and the warranties
     in the Escrow Agreement, Seller makes no representations or warranties,
     express or implied, with respect to the Group, the Business, or the Shares.
     BUYER ACKNOWLEDGES THAT IT HAS CONDUCTED ITS OWN INDEPENDENT DUE DILIGENCE
     AND IS NOT RELYING ON ANY REPRESENTATION, WARRANTY, STATEMENT, OR
     INFORMATION OTHER THAN AS EXPRESSLY SET OUT IN THIS AGREEMENT.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 8
          BUYER'S REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
================================================================================

8.1  Buyer's Warranties. Buyer represents and warrants to Seller as at the date
     of this Agreement and as at the Closing Date that:

     (a) Organisation. Buyer is duly organised, validly existing, and in good
         standing under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation.
     (b) Authority. Buyer has full power and authority to enter into, execute,
         deliver, and perform its obligations under this Agreement. The execution
         and performance of this Agreement have been duly authorised by all
         necessary corporate action.
     (c) Binding Obligation. This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and
         binding obligation of Buyer, enforceable against Buyer in accordance
         with its terms.
     (d) No Conflict. The execution and performance of this Agreement does not
         (i) conflict with or violate Buyer's constitutional documents; (ii) breach
         any agreement to which Buyer is a party; or (iii) violate any applicable
         law or Order.
     (e) Financing. Buyer has, or will have as of Closing, sufficient funds to
         pay the Purchase Price and all other amounts payable by Buyer under
         this Agreement.
     (f) No Proceedings. There are no pending Proceedings that challenge or
         seek to prevent the transactions contemplated by this Agreement.
     (g) No Brokers. No broker, finder, or financial advisor is entitled to any
         fee or commission from Buyer in connection with the transactions
         contemplated by this Agreement.
     (h) Investment Intent. Buyer is acquiring the Shares for its own account
         for investment purposes and not with a view to, or for offer or sale in
         connection with, any distribution thereof in violation of applicable
         securities laws.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 9
                      INDEMNIFICATION
================================================================================

9.1  Indemnification by Seller. Subject to the limitations set out in Section 7.3
     and Schedule 3, Seller shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Buyer
     and its Affiliates (including, after Closing, the Group Companies) and their
     respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors, and assigns
     (collectively, "Buyer Indemnified Parties") from and against any and all
     Losses arising out of or relating to:

     (a) any breach of any Seller's Warranty;
     (b) any breach of any covenant or obligation of Seller in this Agreement;
     (c) Pre-Closing Tax Liabilities to the extent not reflected in the
         Completion Accounts or Locked-Box Price (as applicable); and
     (d) any specific indemnities set out in Schedule 14 (Tax) and Schedule 16
         (Environmental).

9.2  Indemnification by Buyer. Buyer shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless
     Seller and its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers,
     employees, agents, successors, and assigns (collectively, "Seller
     Indemnified Parties") from and against any and all Losses arising out of
     or relating to:

     (a) any breach of any Buyer Warranty; or
     (b) any breach of any covenant or obligation of Buyer in this Agreement.

9.3  Claim Procedure.
     (a) Notice. A party seeking indemnification (the "Indemnified Party")
         shall provide written notice of a Claim to the indemnifying party
         (the "Indemnifying Party") as soon as reasonably practicable, and in
         any event within the applicable time limit in Section 7.3(e).
     (b) Contents. A Claim notice shall set out in reasonable detail (i) the
         nature of the Claim; (ii) the relevant Seller's Warranty (if applicable);
         (iii) the Indemnified Party's best estimate of the Loss; and (iv) the
         basis for the Claim.
     (c) Third-Party Claims. In respect of any Claim arising from a third-party
         claim, the Indemnifying Party shall have the right (but not the
         obligation) to assume control of the defence of such claim at its own
         expense, subject to the Indemnified Party's reasonable cooperation.
     (d) Settlement. The Indemnifying Party shall not settle any third-party
         claim without the Indemnified Party's prior written consent (not to be
         unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed) if such settlement
         imposes any obligation or restriction on the Indemnified Party.

9.4  Exclusive Remedy. Subject to Section 9.5, the indemnification provisions
     of this Article 9 shall be the sole and exclusive remedy of each party
     against the other with respect to any breach of any Seller's Warranty or
     Buyer Warranty (other than as a result of fraud or wilful misconduct).

9.5  Fraud. Nothing in this Agreement shall limit the liability of any party
     for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 10
                         TAX MATTERS
================================================================================

10.1 Pre-Closing Tax Obligations. Seller shall be responsible for, and shall
     indemnify Buyer against, all Tax liabilities of the Group in respect of
     any Pre-Closing Tax Period, to the extent not reflected in the Completion
     Accounts or Locked-Box Price (as applicable).

10.2 Tax Returns. The preparation and filing of Tax Returns and the handling
     of Tax Proceedings are governed by Schedule 14 (Tax Schedule).

10.3 Transfer Taxes. All stamp duty, transfer taxes, and similar impositions
     arising as a result of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement
     shall be borne by [Buyer / as set out in Schedule 14].

10.4 Post-Closing Tax Cooperation. For a period of seven (7) years after the
     Closing Date, each party shall, and shall cause its Affiliates to, provide
     the other party with reasonable cooperation and access to Tax records as
     reasonably required in connection with Tax matters relating to the Group.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 11
                      EMPLOYEE MATTERS
================================================================================

11.1 Transfer. On and after Closing, the employment of all employees of the
     Group shall automatically continue with the relevant Group Company by
     operation of law or, to the extent required by applicable law, Buyer shall
     procure that offers of employment are made to all employees on terms no
     less favourable than their existing terms.

11.2 Employee Covenants. Detailed provisions regarding employee benefits,
     pension schemes, accrued entitlements, redundancy costs, and TUPE/business
     transfer obligations are set out in Schedule 15 (Employee and Benefits
     Schedule).

11.3 Key Employees. Buyer shall use commercially reasonable efforts to retain
     the Key Employees identified in Schedule 8 following Closing.

11.4 No Third-Party Rights. Nothing in this Article 11 shall confer any rights
     or remedies on any employee or former employee of any Group Company.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 12
                    RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS
================================================================================

12.1 Non-Compete. From Closing until the date that is [24/36] months after the
     Closing Date (the "Restricted Period"), Seller shall not, and shall procure
     that its Affiliates do not, directly or indirectly, engage or invest in,
     own, manage, operate, finance, control, or participate in any business that
     competes with the Business as conducted by the Group as of the Closing Date
     in the Restricted Territory.

12.2 Non-Solicitation. During the Restricted Period, Seller shall not, and
     shall procure that its Affiliates do not, directly or indirectly:
     (a) solicit or entice away any Key Employee of the Group; or
     (b) solicit or canvass the custom of any customer or supplier of the Group
         with a view to competing with the Business.

12.3 Non-Disparagement. Each party shall not make, and shall procure that its
     respective Affiliates, officers, and directors do not make, any statement
     that disparages or is reasonably likely to harm the business reputation of
     the other party or, in the case of Seller, the Group.

12.4 Severability of Restrictions. Each restriction in this Article 12 is
     independent. If any restriction is held to be unenforceable, the remaining
     restrictions shall continue in full force and effect.

12.5 Acknowledgement. Seller acknowledges that the restrictions in this Article
     12 are reasonable and necessary to protect the legitimate business interests
     of Buyer and the Group.

================================================================================
                         ARTICLE 13
                     GENERAL PROVISIONS
================================================================================

13.1 Governing Law. This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in
     connection with it (including non-contractual disputes) shall be governed
     by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of [JURISDICTION].

13.2 Dispute Resolution.
     (a) Negotiation. In the event of a dispute, the parties shall first attempt
         to resolve the dispute through good-faith negotiations for a period of
         twenty (20) Business Days from the date of written notice of the dispute.
     (b) Arbitration / Litigation. If the dispute is not resolved through
         negotiation, it shall be finally resolved by [arbitration in accordance
         with the [ICC/LCIA/SIAC/AAA] Rules / proceedings in the courts of
         [JURISDICTION]].

13.3 Entire Agreement. This Agreement (including the Schedules), the Disclosure
     Letter, and the Escrow Agreement constitute the entire agreement between
     the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede all
     prior agreements, understandings, representations, and warranties between
     the parties relating to the subject matter hereof.

13.4 Amendments. No amendment to this Agreement shall be effective unless made
     in writing and signed by duly authorised representatives of each party.

13.5 Notices. All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered
     by hand, courier, or email (with read receipt or written acknowledgement)
     to the addresses set out below [or as updated by notice in writing]:

     To Seller:   [ADDRESS / EMAIL]
                  Attention: [NAME/TITLE]
     To Buyer:    [ADDRESS / EMAIL]
                  Attention: [NAME/TITLE]

13.6 Assignment. Neither party may assign any of its rights or obligations under
     this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, except
     that Buyer may assign its rights (but not its obligations) to any of its
     Affiliates, provided that Buyer shall remain jointly and severally liable
     for all of Buyer's obligations hereunder.

13.7 No Waiver. No failure or delay by a party in exercising any right or remedy
     under this Agreement shall constitute a waiver of that right or remedy.

13.8 Severability. If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid,
     illegal, or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full
     force and effect, and the parties shall negotiate in good faith a valid
     substitute provision that, to the greatest extent possible, achieves the
     original purpose of the invalid provision.

13.9 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which
     shall constitute an original, and all of which together shall constitute
     one and the same instrument. Electronic signatures shall be deemed valid.

13.10 Third-Party Rights. Except as expressly stated, this Agreement does not
      confer any rights on any third party under any applicable third-party
      rights legislation.

13.11 Termination.
      (a) This Agreement may be terminated at any time prior to Closing:
